name: brutal
description: Neo-brutalist posters (Gumroad / Figma-community style): one loud flat colour per slide from a fixed lemon, pink, mint, lilac, orange, sky sequence, black ink everywhere, chunky Archivo Black headlines with one word on a tilted sticker, 5px black outlines and hard offset shadows on every card, tag and button, a black swipe tag in the footer, and every visual redrawn as white outlined cards with hard shadows.
source: Free theme (off-brand by design), built for the 'looks entirely different from the brand' request, October 2026. Direction: neo-brutalism as seen on Gumroad and Figma community files.
best_for: tool, product and how-to posts with UI visuals
playful or community posts that should not look corporate

variant: (none: the per-slide colour sequence is the system)
slide fields: fill: true turns any slide black with lemon stickers (quote does this by default)
